name: ai-engineer-benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset intended to assess AI systems in tasks relevant to 'AI engineer' workflows — likely including system design, prompt/curriculum engineering, and multi-step coding or automation tasks. It measures both the quality of generated technical artifacts and correctness of solutions across engineering-style problems.
evaluation_method: human_eval for open-ended engineering outputs and pass@k / unit-test-based correctness for generated code/components
general_score_metric: Human evaluation (quality/utility) and pass@k or task-success_rate for code- and tool-oriented tasks
reputation: A niche community dataset with limited visibility; used by a small set of practitioners experimenting with agent-style or engineering-task evaluation.
